notes: Three co-transmitters at the head converge at خالد بن مخلد («قالوا حدثنا»): one level (rule 2)
«أبو كريب، محمد بن العلاء» is one man (rule 7: kunya, comma, name)
The second saying («وقال قال رسول الله») comes from the same speaker, Abu Hurayra, with no isnad of its own: one chain, not a ruling case
